d:
Di lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. jamega 22, 23 aur 24 navanbar 2024 ko dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men. 3 dinon ke lie banie adde ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie par die bainar par klik kijie
The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra reached Bhognadih village of the Barhait assembly seat in the Sahibganj district. Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar talked to some of the people here to know the condition of alleged Conversion and Land disputes among two communities.
